value.rationale: Resolves an explicitly posed all-network interior-uniqueness/isolation question in the original model. Converts a stochastic convergence-to-set prediction in the regime of two unstable consensus endpoints into almost-sure selection of one deterministic nonconsensus outcome, and gives constructively convergent monotone upper/lower bounds. This is a structural theorem for every finite connected nonbipartite weighted network, not a renamed general theorem or a one-parameter numerical exercise.
